changes.new_text: The electrical connections inside the boot and occupant compartment shall comply with at least the minimum protection degree class IP 40 according to IEC Standard 60529-1989+A1:1999+A2:2013 or IP40 according to ISO20653:2013.
changes.reason: Paragraph 6.17.2.1 of UN R67 was amended in version 4.3.0: 'passengers' became 'occupant'.

changes.new_text: In an occupant compartment or enclosed luggage compartment the gas tube or hose shall be no longer than reasonably required; this provision is fulfilled when the gas tube or hose does not extend further than from the fuel container to the side of vehicle.
changes.reason: Paragraph 17.8.8 of UN R67 was amended in version 4.3.0: 'a passenger' became 'an occupant'.

changes.new_text: There shall be no gas-conveying connections in the occupant compartment or enclosed luggage compartment with the exception of:
changes.reason: Paragraph 17.8.8.1 of UN R67 was amended in version 4.3.0: 'passenger' became 'occupant'.

changes.new_text: When the LPG container is installed in the occupant compartment or enclosed (luggage) compartment the filling unit shall be located at the outside of the vehicle.
changes.reason: Paragraph 17.10.2 of UN R67 was amended in version 4.3.0: 'passenger' became 'occupant'; 'an' was removed; 'compartment,' became 'compartment'.

changes.new_text: The electrical connections inside the boot and occupant compartment shall comply with protection degree class IP 40 according to IEC Standard 605291989+A1:1999.
changes.reason: Paragraph 17.11.4 of UN R67 was amended in version 4.3.0: 'passengers' became 'occupant'.

changes.new_text: The present requirement shall be fulfilled also in case of faults by use of a malfunction indication to the driver or sent as a logic signal to ADS, and optionally activation of limp home mode.
changes.reason: Paragraph 17.13.2.3 of UN R67 was amended in version 4.3.0: 'driver,' became 'driver or sent as a logic signal to ADS,'.

changes.new_text: Such a fault shall be clearly indicated to the driver or sent as a logic signal to ADS.
changes.reason: Paragraph Annex 14 6 of UN R67 was amended in version 4.3.0: 'driver.' became 'driver or sent as a logic signal to ADS.'.
